Payments Architecture : Card Fraud Alerts Design

Created by Sample Author, last modified on Jun 03, 2019

Overview

Card Authorisation Switch calls the Fraud Scoring Engine for each card transaction. The Fraud Scoring Engine triggers the Case Management System when a score is high.

Deployment view

The Payments Hub is not changed by this design.
